what: Step 3: Plot champions against the field
title: rescue-an-elo-plot
text: Grey lines show field context; coloured lines draw attention champions.
code: ggplot(elo_flagged, aes(date, rating, group = player_id)) +   geom_line(     data = filter(elo_flagged, !champion),     colour = "grey80"   ) +   geom_line(     data = filter(elo_flagged, champion),     aes(colour = player_name),     linewidth = 1   ) +   labs(     x = NULL,     y = "Elo rating",     colour = "World Champion",     title = "Recent World Champions against the field"   ) +   theme_minimal()

what: Step 4: Who is on top now?
title: rescue-an-elo-plot
text: recent_players() keeps established player’s latest rating. 2026 champion appear plot rating snapshot history . See ?recent_champions.
code: recent_players(pokemon_elo) |>   slice_max(rating, n = 5) #> # A tibble: 5 × 5 #>   player_id      player_name    date       rating events #>   <chr>          <chr>          <date>      <dbl>  <int> #> 1 wolfe-glick    Wolfe Glick    2026-06-12  2045.     38 #> 2 eric-rios      Eric Rios      2026-06-12  2022.     40 #> 3 paul-chua      Paul Chua      2026-05-29  2008      46 #> 4 marco-silva    Marco Silva    2026-06-12  1999.     45 #> 5 luca-ceribelli Luca Ceribelli 2025-11-29  1997.     19
